Encryption ​

Needs Skapi(projectId:encryption:) with an EncryptionOptions. See Encrypting Private Data. Every method that throws, throws SkapiError.

EncryptionOptions ​

swift
struct EncryptionOptions {
    init(iterations: Int = 600000, trustPolicy: TrustPolicy = .tofu, withheld: Withheld = .null, recovery: Recovery = .code,
         table: String = "__skapi__keyring", persistDevice: Bool = true, deviceKeyStorage: SkapiStorage? = nil)
}
swift
let skapi = try Skapi(projectId: "<Project ID>", encryption: EncryptionOptions())
fielddefault
iterations600000PBKDF2 rounds for new password wraps; at least 100000
recovery.code.none: no encryption recovery codes
trustPolicy.tofu.strict: only pinned keys are used for sharing
withheld.null.sentinel: undecryptable data is {"__skapi_no_access__": true, "reason": ...}
table"__skapi__keyring"the table that holds keyrings
persistDevicetrueremember this device: after a password unlock, keep the master key in the Keychain (this device only) so a session restored at launch is unlocked without the password. logout removes it. See Remembering this device.
deviceKeyStoragenilwhere the remembered key is kept. Left out: the Keychain, this device only, readable after the first unlock.
codemessage
INVALID_PARAMETER"encryption.iterations" must be at least 100000. (thrown by Skapi(projectId:encryption:))

getEncryptionStatus ​

swift
func getEncryptionStatus() async -> JSON

Does not throw. Waits for an unlock from this device's remembered key that is still running.

json
{"status": "disabled"}
{"status": "locked", "reason": "NO_SESSION_KEY" | "OPENID_UNSUPPORTED", "user_id"?: "...", "fingerprint"?: "..."}
{"status": "unlocked", "user_id": "...", "fingerprint": "..."}

fingerprint is the user's own public key fingerprint, for others to pin.

unlockEncryption ​

swift
func unlockEncryption(password: String) async throws -> JSON

Opens the keyring with the password. Returns {"status": "unlocked"}. With persistDevice, this device remembers the key from then on. It never sets encryption up: that happens at the first login with the password, so an account that has never logged in with its password gets NOT_EXISTS. See Unlocking.

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTEncryption is not enabled for this instance.
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required.
INVALID_PARAMETER"password" is required.
NOT_EXISTSEncryption has not been set up for this account yet. It is set up at the first login with the password: log in with the password to start using it.
ENCRYPTION_BAD_PASSWORDIncorrect password: the encryption keyring could not be opened.
ENCRYPTION_KEYRING_CORRUPTThe encryption keyring does not belong to this user. / The keyring has no password wrap.
ENCRYPTION_LOCKEDEncryption could not be unlocked: <reason>

lockEncryption ​

swift
func lockEncryption(forgetDevice: Bool = false) async -> JSON

Does not throw. Forgets the keys in memory. forgetDevice: true also removes the key this device remembers, so the next launch asks for the password again. Returns {"status": "locked"}, or {"status": "disabled"}. An encryption recovery code not collected yet is kept: the next getConnectionInfo() still returns it, once.

isWithheld ​

swift
nonisolated func isWithheld(_ value: JSON?) -> Bool

true for the .sentinel placeholder of undecryptable data. It is nonisolated, so it needs no await:

swift
if skapi.isWithheld(record["data"]) { /* this session cannot read it */ }

Encryption recovery code ​

Shown once, in getConnectionInfo as "encryption_recovery", after the first password login with encryption on. See Encryption recovery codes.

unlockEncryptionWithRecoveryCode ​

swift
func unlockEncryptionWithRecoveryCode(_ code: String, password: String? = nil) async throws -> JSON

Unlocks encryption with the saved encryption recovery code, for a user signed in after a password reset. With password, the keyring opens with that password from now on. The code is replaced by a new one.

json
{"status": "unlocked", "repaired": true, "encryptionRecoveryCode": "<new code>"}

encryptionRecoveryCode is null with recovery: .none.

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTEncryption is not enabled for this instance.
INVALID_REQUESTUser login is required. Reset the password and log in first, then use the encryption recovery code.
INVALID_PARAMETER"code" is required.
NOT_EXISTSThis account has no encryption keyring, so there is nothing to recover.
ENCRYPTION_BAD_RECOVERY_CODEThat does not look like an encryption recovery code: expected 28 characters, got <n>. / ... "<c>" is not a valid character. / That encryption recovery code has a typo in it: the check characters do not match. / That encryption recovery code did not open the keyring. ...

regenerateEncryptionRecoveryCode ​

swift
func regenerateEncryptionRecoveryCode() async throws -> JSON

A new encryption recovery code, {"encryptionRecoveryCode": "..."}; the old one stops working. Needs encryption unlocked.

codemessage
INVALID_REQUESTEncryption is not enabled for this instance.
ENCRYPTION_LOCKEDEncryption must be unlocked to issue an encryption recovery code. ...
INVALID_REQUESTEncryption recovery codes are turned off for this instance ("encryption.recovery" is "none").
ENCRYPTION_KEYRING_CORRUPTThe encryption keyring could not be read. / This keyring predates encryption recovery code rotation and cannot issue a new code. ...

pinPeerKey ​

swift
func pinPeerKey(userId: String, fingerprint: String) async throws

Trusts fingerprint as userId's key for sharing, saved in the keyring. Returns nothing. Throws ENCRYPTION_LOCKED (Encryption is locked.) when not unlocked.

Errors from other methods ​

With encryption on, these can come from postRecord, postRecords, uploadFiles, getFile, grantPrivateRecordAccess, removePrivateRecordAccess and changePassword:

codewhen
ENCRYPTION_LOCKEDwriting a private record, changing the password, or opening an encrypted file while locked
ENCRYPTION_BAD_PASSWORDchangePassword with a wrong current password
ENCRYPTION_NOT_RECORD_OWNERwriting another user's encrypted record
ENCRYPTION_CANNOT_REWRITE_WITHHELDwriting back a withheld placeholder
ENCRYPTED_DATA_TOO_LARGEthe encrypted data is over 2 MB
ENCRYPTION_GRANT_REQUIRES_OWNERsharing or removing access on a record you do not own
ENCRYPTION_RECIPIENT_HAS_NO_KEYthe user never signed in with encryption on
ENCRYPTION_PEER_KEY_CHANGED / ENCRYPTION_PEER_NOT_PINNEDsee Sharing
ENCRYPTION_DATA_UNAVAILABLEthe record's data could not be read while changing its sharing
ENCRYPTION_FILE_CORRUPT / ENCRYPTION_FILE_STALE_KEYan encrypted file does not open with the record's key
INVALID_PARAMETER"__skapi_enc__" is a reserved key in record data. / "__skenc__" is reserved in an upload form key.
